{{Quote|What do you know about the Llon Nebulae, my young apprentice?''"<br />"''Smaller cruisers are advised to proceed at minimum velocity. Atmospheric waves can appear without warning.''"<br />"''And yet you decided to play 'chase the asteroid.' You're too old for these childish games.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] as they approached the Kronex spaceport|<ref name="Storm Fleet Warnings">{{StoryCite|story=Storm Fleet Warnings|book=Star Wars: Short Story Collection}}</ref>}}
The '''Llon Nebulae''', located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], was the site of the [[Battle of the Llon Nebulae]], where the [[Storm Fleet]] incurred some losses.
